mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_conversation ( user_id, conversation_id, title, status, message_count, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{title}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), COALESCE(#{messageCount}, 0), #{lastMessageAt}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, conversation_id, title, status, message_count, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}

SELECT id, user_id, conversation_id, title, status, message_count, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, updated_at, created_at) DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_conversation SET message_count = message_count + COALESCE(#{messageIncrement}, 0), last_message_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
